title: Customs Control Act 31 of 2014
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. The commencement note reads 'Takes effect on a date determined by the President by proclamation in the Gazette', and no proclamation is recorded. The Customs Duty Act 30 of 2014 page (/documents/customs-duty-act) says it 'Takes effect on the date on which the Customs Control Act takes effect'. The Legal Data Hunter check was rate-limited.
notes: Probably not yet in force; together with Customs Duty Act 30 of 2014 it is meant to replace Act 91 of 1964. Commencement has not been confirmed from a proclamation.
